slug: 2025-10-13 Somalia moves to finalize Digital Transformation Strategy 2025-2030 with ITU support

systems.tiers: launched 'nationwide' in August 2025, as the document puts it

note: The document is about the validation workshop for the Digital Transformation Strategy 2025-2030 (12-13 October 2025). Its one sentence in the field says that in August 2025 Somalia launched a Unified Digital Civil Registration Service nationwide. The service is named with no description of what it does, where records are made or by whom, so it is left unclassified and no fact is taken; the parent may want the dated launch (2025-08) for the last-twelve-months aspect once another source classes the system.
